heading: Thursday, September 4, 2025
topLine: AI controller cuts noise in LIGO's hardest mirror-control loop by 30 to 100 times.

items.headline: AI controller cuts noise in LIGO's hardest mirror-control loop by 30 to 100 times
items.summary: Google DeepMind, LIGO/Caltech and the Gran Sasso Science Institute used Deep Loop Shaping, reinforcement learning with frequency-domain rewards, to design a controller for LIGO's most unstable feedback loop, reducing control noise 30 to 100 times in the 10-30 Hz band on the Livingston detector. Published in Science and validated on the real instrument; Caltech describes it as a proof of concept that, extended to all loops, could add many detections per year.
